title: The Lord's Vision and the Five Woes
description: The prophet Habakkuk receives a vision from the Lord and is told to write it clearly on tablets. The vision declares that the proud shall fall, but the righteous shall live by their faith. Then follow five 'woe' cries against greed and plunder, unjust gain, bloody city-building, humiliation of one's neighbor, and idol worship. Amidst judgment comes the promise that the earth will be filled with knowledge of the Lord's glory, and the vision ends with the call: 'Be silent before him, all the earth!' [ref:Hab 2:2-20|Habakkuk 2:2-20].
